patterns.note: Content is presented within a consistent, centrally aligned narrow column, providing ample negative space on a full-bleed dark background.
Clear typographic hierarchy uses bold sans-serif headings for sections and questions, with lighter weight sans-serif for body text and accent-colored, underlined links.
A deep, dark purple background (#281733) provides a strong contrast for light text and a vibrant purple/pink accent color for interactive elements and branding.
No scroll-triggered motion or animation is observed; content simply scrolls into view without reveals, parallax, or sticky element transformations.
Feature descriptions are presented in a two-column grid layout, transitioning to a single-column for FAQs and support information.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-bleed dark background color that extends across the viewport, with all primary content constrained to a fixed-width container centered horizontally.
Typographic emphasis is achieved through varying font weights and sizes for headings and body text, with interactive links distinguished by an accent color and underline.
The navigation bar remains static at the top of the page, maintaining its initial appearance and position as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced sans-serif headings (~2x body) with clear weight distinction, providing strong readability against a dark background.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and input fields have a slight corner radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (generous vertical spacing between sections, comfortable line height and paragraph spacing within content blocks).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark purple background paired with a vibrant, almost neon-like purple accent color for links and the logo creates a unique, modern, and slightly mysterious aesthetic for a developer tool. This strong color contrast and minimal layout make the content feel sharp and focused.
